candidate_c.reuse: Keep sealed-block counts only within one assembly call. Compute each previously accepted block plus separator once, then count only the new header/content. Supplemental stable-prefix checks may use the new header and the exactly sealed earlier-token total. No state or source/query text survives the call.
candidate_c.safe_fit_bound: For a certified strict-UTF-8 block, its UTF-8 byte length is an upper bound on its ordinary token count. If exact sealed-prefix tokens plus this bound fit, preserve that first-fit acceptance without an immediate encode. Final context_tokens must still be computed exactly; a later rejection cannot replace the accepted context or count.
candidate_c.token_boundary_hypothesis: Every actual citation block begins with '[' and accepted blocks are joined by exactly two LF characters. For the two exact registered tokenizer regexes, no pretokenizer alternative consumes the terminal LF and then '['. At the left segment's end, cl100k's end-of-string whitespace alternative consumes the same whole trailing whitespace as its newline alternative because the segment ends with LF. Therefore the sealed previous block plus separator and the next citation block are separate BPE pieces; their token-ID concatenation, and thus counts, are exact. This is a certified specific boundary, not arbitrary token-count additivity.

bounded_highlight_read.hypothesis: SQLite EXPLAIN on an invented schema shows MATCH plus rowid IN repeats the virtual scan per rowid, while MATCH plus a rowid range and unary-plus whitelist uses one bounded scan.
bounded_highlight_read.rule: Only when at least two selected truncated rowids lie within a span of at most 256, add the exact redundant minimum/maximum bounds and apply the identical whitelist through +rowid IN. Single-id and wide-span requests keep the historical query. Highlighted bodies and keyed results must match exactly.

bounded_index_features.accounting: A conservative retained-object upper bound includes sets, strings, entry/key objects and the cache container. Oversized entries are used for the current query but not retained. Both entry and byte bounds are mandatory; no tuning these limits from measured outcomes.
bounded_index_features.measurement: Document the derived-feature cache separately from the disabled result cache. Each isolated worker starts with a fresh connection and empty feature cache; it may warm across queries. Keep first/repeat-round and RSS/startup results. Fresh correctness fixtures must compare empty/warm/evicted features and verify no source read escapes the transaction.
bounded_index_features.scope: One MemoryBook connection only; key by integer page rid within the archive revision captured by the existing read transaction. Clear all entries on a changed captured revision and on close. Fetch every miss from that same snapshot.
bounded_index_features.semantics: The novelty and temporal rules continue to receive exactly qset intersect body.split() for every page. API writes, other-connection writes and deletion/reused rowids are invalidated by the committed archive revision. Result-cache clear/write operations cannot invalidate immutable source features or alter them.
bounded_index_features.value: Immutable frozenset of a page's existing pretokenized indexed body; no new normalization, query, score, rank, result or embedding is cached.

candidate_b.metadata_copy: Reuse the already private per-candidate metadata dictionary instead of copying it again. Original SQLite rows, route order, tie breaks, scores and scopes stay unchanged.

formal.failure_rule: If the sole bounded candidate fails correctness, fix a demonstrated implementation bug and retain the failed attempt. If a valid candidate misses the performance gate, report it and do not advertise or ship it as a measured speedup. No selecting the fastest run.
formal.gate: No complete non-timing payload mismatch or invariant failure. Across all twelve cohort/configuration cells, geometric-mean pooled p95 improves by at least 10%; at least one public native token-budget cell improves p95 by at least 15%; public actual-MCP token1024 improves p95 by at least 10%; no pooled cell p50 or p95 regresses by more than 5%. Retain all samples and rounds. A startup, ingestion, unchanged replay or RSS mean increase over 10% requires an explicit cause assessment and independent review, not replacement timing.
